name: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology
nameVi: Bảo tàng Dân tộc học Việt Nam
kicker: Galleries and outdoor houses in Nghia Do
summary: Head out to Nghia Do for the Museum of Ethnology. Indoor galleries cover Vietnam's 54 ethnic groups, and the outdoor ground holds full-size stilt houses and thatched buildings set among trees. Leave as much time for the outdoor houses as for the galleries. The museum is closed on Mondays.
heroCaption: An outdoor house at the Museum of Ethnology

notice.title: Closed Monday
notice.body: The museum is closed every Monday and over the New Year holiday.

body: The outdoor ground holds wooden houses on stilts and smaller thatched buildings set in the trees. Inside, the galleries cover Vietnam's 54 ethnic groups.
This is not a walk from the lake: the museum is on Nguyen Van Huyen Street in Nghia Do, west of the center. Go on any day but Monday, and give the outdoor houses as much time as the galleries.

figures.caption: A path and a thatched house in the outdoor ground
figures.alt: A path beside a thatched house at the Museum of Ethnology

gettingThere: The museum is on Nguyen Van Huyen Street, Nghia Do, west of the center. Take a car or motorbike from Hoan Kiem.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem
legs.body: By car or motorbike to Nguyen Van Huyen Street.

hours: 8:30–17:30. Closed Monday and over New Year (museum site: New Year's Holiday; English brochure: Lunar New Year).
closed: Monday, and the New Year holiday.
